[IDSP.7.5] **NULL callback policy: OPTIONAL, per-op.** The
persistence callbacks are not essential — a NULL `set_cb`
/ `delete_cb` is not an error. The verb still mutates the
engine's cache; the write is simply not persisted (a
volatile cache, [LSTO.4.3.2]). An integrator wires either,
both, or neither; `cache-get` needs no callback at all. No
cache verb ever returns `DS_ERR_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE`.
